title: fable-mode: a Claude Code skill that adds explicit planning, sub-agent delegation

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Claude Fable 5 earns its reputation through how it works. Explicit multi-stage planning, delegating to sub aents, and verifying its own output before it trusts it. Fable mode bottles that behavior as a skill. drop it into clawed code and it activates that same discipline loop.
